name: Discord
one_liner: Discord API: REST and Gateway APIs for building bots and apps that interact with Discord data.
auth_notes: Bot token from the Developer Portal sent as 'Authorization: Bot TOKEN'; OAuth2 user tokens for acting on behalf of a user; Basic auth with client ID and secret only for OAuth2 token endpoints.
access_notes: Credentials are self-serve: a bot user is created in the Developer Portal and generates a bot token. Some OAuth2 scopes need approval from Discord. Cost is not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve bot token, documented REST and Gateway API, standard token auth, no approval gate for basic bot use. Pricing and sandbox are not stated on the fetched pages.
